title: ts-starter stamp
description: The stamp.json of a stamp in stamps/<name>/<variant>/

mode.description: `project` creates a new directory and needs a prompt called `name`, `inject` adds files to a directory

prompts.description: Questions asked for this stamp, the answers are available as variables in `*.hbs` and `package.json` files

includes.description: Inject stamps applied before this stamp's own files, as `<stamp>:<variant>`

files.description: Directory, relative to the stamp.json, holding the files of this stamp

npm.description: Path, relative to the stamp.json, of a package.json that only lists dependencies, devDependencies and/or peerDependencies. They are added to the package.json of the target, a package that is already listed keeps its version. The file itself is not written.

patches.description: Changes to JSON files of the target: objects are merged, arrays get the missing values, other values are replaced

file.description: Path of a .json file relative to the target directory

default.description: A string for `input`, a boolean for `confirm`
